text: You received your order #W2378156 and wish to exchange the mechanical keyboard for the same one but with clicky switches and the smart thermostat for one compatible with Google Home instead of Apple HomeKit. If there is no keyboard that is clicky, RGB backlight, full size, you'd go for no backlight.
zh: 您收到了订单 #W2378156，希望将机械键盘换成同款但带有咔哒声开关的，将智能恒温器换成兼容 Google Home 的而不是 Apple HomeKit 的。如果没有带咔哒声开关、RGB 背光、全尺寸的键盘，您会选不带背光的。
